people.name: Noor
people.paper_habit: tears strips off whatever is nearest: lined, graph, receipts
people.life: art teacher at a secondary school; quiet 8:30 to 15:30 except a burst at lunch; long evenings; keeps a sketchbook; flat by the canal in the east; hates the phone ringing

people.name: Teo
people.paper_habit: folds things: thirds, halves, corners turned down
people.life: night-shift nurse on a respiratory ward; three or four nights a week, silent from 19:30 to 08:00 then a flood at 08:15; sleeps until 15:00 on shift days; flat near the hospital in the north; cooks on days off

world.city: an unnamed river city with a canal in the east, a hospital on the hill, a ferry to a small island in summer
in_jokes: the pigeon: a pigeon got into Noor's classroom in October 2025 and lived on top of the cupboard for a day; 'the pigeon' now means anything that refuses to leave
tuesday soup: Teo's day-off soup, never the same twice, rated by Noor out of ten with unfair criteria
left sock: Noor lost one sock at Teo's in December 2025; it has never turned up; any lost thing is 'with the sock'
the lift: they were stuck in the hospital car park lift for forty minutes in August 2026; 'in the lift' means stuck anywhere
the good pen: Noor's one pen that Teo keeps borrowing
logistics: bins on Wednesday at Noor's, Thursday at Teo's
whose turn to book the dentist
bread from the place by the bridge
Teo's shift roster arriving every fourth Friday
Noor's marking piles at half term
the boiler at Noor's that needs the pressure topped up

anchors.what: the night of the lift: a run of messages from inside the stuck lift, a photo of the lift buttons, a `here` feeling from Teo, the note that trails off when the doors open
the ferry to the island: planned in May, scheduled in June, done and rated in July, and the two-year anniversary on 2026-11-09 counting down in the calendar
the first key: a milestone the day Teo got a key to Noor's flat, with the photo of the key on the table and the `did_it` feeling that went with it
